items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: Hatchet, me and him. I got him jobs as men in Arkansas for white people. I show Hatchet.

ctx.x: I was going anywhere. I'd been fouling about something. Because they were too loud. It's a million times, I don't know. But I was trying to find that here.
I don't know. We'd go around and they found the box here. Did you know a piano player named Johnny Hodge in Memphis?

No. Hatchet, I didn't call anything. Hatchet, I know him. Hatchet, his first name? Yeah, Hatchet, me and him. I got him jobs as men in Arkansas for white people. I show Hatchet. They used to call him the Axe. Hatchet's a hot, deep slug. Something like, some big, like Himes in there. And, boom, them hard tents, you know.
